entries.zhHans: 当接触到特定光像图案或频闪闪光刺激时，有极少部分人（如癫痫症患者，甚至部分未确诊人员）会出现“光敏性癫痫”症状，包括眩晕、面色发紫、眼部或面部抽搐、口吐白沫、意识混乱或失去意识、全身强直等。如果您、您的家人或您的其他家庭成员曾经有过类似症状，请在游戏前听从医生的专业意见。若您在游戏过程中出现上述症状，请立即停止游戏并尽快就医，并在继续游戏前听从医生的专业意见。
entries.en: When exposed to specific light patterns or strobe flashes, a small number of people (such as those with epilepsy, and even some undiagnosed individuals) may experience "photosensitive epilepsy" symptoms, including dizziness, bluish complexion, eye or facial twitching, foaming at the mouth, confusion or loss of consciousness, and generalized stiffness. If you, your family members, or other family members have ever had similar symptoms, please follow the professional advice of your doctor before playing the game. If you experience the above symptoms during the game, stop playing immediately and seek medical attention as soon as possible. And follow the professional advice of your doctor before resuming the game.

entries.zhHans:
1.本游戏是一款开放世界动作类游戏，适用于年满16周岁及以上的用户，建议未成年人在家长监护下使用游戏产品。

2.本游戏基于架空的故事背景和世界观，与真实历史和现实世界均无任何关联。

3.根据国家相关要求，本游戏中有用户实名认证系统，未通过实名认证的用户不可进入游戏；
游戏中部分玩法和道具需要付费。认证为未成年的用户将接受以下管理：未满8周岁的用户不得进行充值；8周岁以上但未满16周
岁的未成年人用户，单次充值金额不得超过50元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过200元人民币；16周岁以上的未成年人用
户，单次充值金额不得超过100元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过400元人民币。
游戏仅会在周五、周六、周日及法定节假日的20时至21时，向未成年人提供1小时游戏服务。

4.游戏中设置了主线及丰富的支线剧情，并且提供了开放世界探索玩法。游戏内有丰富多彩的剧情，精美的游戏画面，优质的游戏
entries.en:
398/5000
This game is an open-world action game suitable for users aged 16 and above. It is recommended that minors use the game product under the supervision of their parents. 
2. This game is based on an imaginary story background and world view, and has no connection whatsoever with real history or the real world. 
3. In accordance with the relevant requirements of the country, this game has a user real-name authentication system. Users who have not passed the real-name authentication cannot enter the game.
Some gameplay and items in the game require payment. For users who have not reached the age of majority, the following management will be implemented: Users under the age of 8 are not allowed to make any recharge; for minors aged between 8 and 16, the single recharge amount shall not exceed 50 RMB, and the cumulative recharge amount per month shall not exceed 200 RMB; for minors over 16 years old, the single recharge amount shall not exceed 100 RMB, and the cumulative recharge amount per month shall not exceed 400 RMB.
The game will only provide 1 hour of game service for minors from 20:00 to 21:00 on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and during legal holidays. 
4. The game features a main storyline along with numerous side quests, and offers an open-world exploration mode. The game contains a rich variety of storylines, stunning graphics, and high-quality gameplay.
